findings.title: All 1,780 numeric cells reconcile to the acquired sources or stated formulas
findings.body: The verifier reran its own source-reading helpers against the frozen dataset: 1,018 core cells plus 762 remaining cells, with no numeric mismatch or unverified numeric row. This checks transcription and calculations, not the administrative databases, source signatures, or every source-register URL.
findings.recommendation: Describe the result as a scoped numeric and source review, not certification or 1,780 independently observed people/cases.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: Concluded-case averages do not estimate the wait of current or new applicants
findings.body: MSWiA regional means concern concluded proceedings; unfinished cases are absent. Rounded regional means have no supplied regional weights for a national mean. Full-year 2023 and partial 2026 differ in period and case mix. Their arithmetic comparison does not identify a causal change in administrative efficiency. Calendar-versus-working-day conventions are not independently established for every reporting system.

evidence.locator: table 1; footnote cut-off 06.07.2026
duration tables, cut-off 12.08.2026; public document copy

findings.recommendation: Keep 'reported mean of concluded proceedings', exact cut-off, partial-year notice and no individual-wait forecast beside the chart and shared cards.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: UdSC regional attribution is reconstruction rather than direct authentication
findings.body: The public copy hides regional names. The 16 numeric rows are legible, and their national sums do not depend on names. Regional mapping relies on row-order reconstruction and the 2023 match to MSWiA; Blue Card inherits the row-order assumption. A unique numeric match supports the reconstruction but does not reveal a redacted label or authenticate the original letter.

evidence.locator: pp. 3–4, hidden region labels; source-access class primary_document_copy_snapshot

findings.recommendation: Retain the reconstructed-geography quality flag and visible caveat. Avoid calling a regional value directly read from a named original row.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: NSA annual stock boundaries differ by one case twice
findings.body: The national 6272 end stock is 820 in 2023 while the 2024 opening stock is 821; the 2024 end stock is 930 while the 2025 opening stock is 929. Each dataset cell agrees with the corresponding official annual workbook and each annual movement identity reconciles. No cause for the cross-year differences has been established.

evidence.locator: 2023, 2024, 2025 annual XLS; sheet WSA SAB Symbole; national symbol 6272, Excel row 249

findings.recommendation: Do not silently correct source figures, claim exact interyear stock continuity, or attribute the differences to revisions without evidence. Add a short note if stock movement across years is visualized.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: Court denominator, subject scope and disposed-case cohort matter
findings.body: Symbol 6272 includes visas, residence, settlement and expulsion, not residence permits alone. 432/(432+1032)=29.508197% in 2025 is the upheld share among merits dispositions. Rejected complaints, other dispositions and administrative closures have different categories. Annual disposed cases are not the cohort filed that year. These shares do not identify a new claimant's success probability or causal court performance.

evidence.locator: 2025 XLS, WSA SAB Symbole, symbol 6272; disposition columns and Załatwiono/Zamknięto distinction

findings.recommendation: Keep all outcome categories and the actual denominator visible; use blank-count-as-zero only under the documented existing-row reconciliation rule.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: Warehouse periods and outcome cohorts cannot be interchanged
findings.body: The 48 Podlaski warehouse cells for 2026 have an unknown operational cut-off; the report generation date does not establish it. All-outcome resolutions include positive and negative decisions, discontinuance and leaving an application unexamined. Łódź positive-only legal-basis cohorts and maximum durations are separate statistics; the latter are reported database maxima, not independently authenticated individual case histories. Source validation also removed duplicate IDs and substituted registration dates for specified old submission dates.

evidence.locator: definitions warehouse_resolutions / positive_resolution_duration and 48 period_ambiguous observations

findings.recommendation: Preserve null 2026 cut-offs and exclude these partial/ambiguous cells from an annual scenario baseline. Keep outcome cohorts and duration maxima separately labelled.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: Stocks, portal flows and staff ratios do not form a single cohort model
findings.body: UdSC stock and Łódź office stock have different cut-offs and incompletely matched scopes. Headcount is a snapshot of people, not annual FTE. Pending/headcount is a workload proxy, not productivity. Portal applications and decisions are counts by event year, not unique persons or the same filing cohort. Acquisition time is not an independently known operational cut-off. A stock divided by annual output is a conditional workload ratio, not an expected wait; stock-flow reconciliation also needs other movements.

evidence.locator: definitions lodz_scope, caseworkers, stock_per_caseworker, portal_flow, scenario

findings.recommendation: Keep source/scope differences and scenario assumptions beside the values; do not infer missing cases, productivity, future LTR eligibility or a representative migrant wait distribution.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: API identifier semantics need a separately cited dictionary
findings.body: The 16 preserved API response bodies allow country totals to be reconciled but expose only country and total. They do not themselves explain caseType=1 and caseType=3. The current labels agree with the portal/CSV discovery context; no incorrect mapping has been demonstrated. A preserved official dictionary or exact official UI configuration would make that attribution independently reproducible.

evidence.locator: 16 migracje.gov.pl API snapshots; numeric country totals

findings.recommendation: Add the official identifier dictionary/locator if available. Do not describe the absence as proof of a wrong mapping.
findings.final_disposition: Official caseType dictionary independently read and hash-checked; see phase3-review.json.

findings.title: The original core reuses the source collection discovered through Głos Migranta
findings.body: All 32 parsed/supporting source acquisitions were discovered through Głos Migranta pages/downloads or its cited official NSA index. Directly fetching 24 official-publisher snapshots improves provenance and reproducibility but does not, by itself, create newly collected empirical cases. Eight acquisitions are public copies of official documents. The current README and footer credit Głos Migranta and do not claim affiliation; that attribution is fair and must survive the expanded comparison.

evidence.locator: sources[].notes / access / status
acquisition routes; independently compared with the original source register

findings.recommendation: Credit the collection, documents, datasets and prior calculations. State our contribution as selected source rechecking, normalization, explicit definitions, reproducible code and visualization. Do not call Głos Migranta only a link list or claim new primary fieldwork for these 32 sources.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: Source links, profiled rows and normalized cells are different coverage units
findings.body: The source register contains 1,483 records, with 32 parsed/supporting acquisitions and 1,451 catalogued-only entries. The normalized 1,780 observations are indicator cells, including derived shares and repeated fields, not 1,780 people or independent cases. Profiling 6,625 upstream CSV rows is a structural inventory, not a full factual audit of all their claims. Neither this administrative selection nor a future volunteer questionnaire is a representative sample of all migrants.

evidence.locator: summary
structural profiling scope, separate from source-value verification

findings.recommendation: Publish these units separately. Do not give catalogue entries reviewed status or infer survey prevalence/population averages from voluntary responses.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.

findings.title: Do not transfer the TZTC identity rule to an ordinary application certificate
findings.body: The official UKNF response concerns Belarusian international-protection applicants and expressly recognizes the Tymczasowe Zaświadczenie Tożsamości Cudzoziemca (TZTC). That statutory identity document is not the same document as an ordinary residence-application receipt, MOS confirmation or passport stamp. A statement that every 'zaświadczenie' proves identity would overextend this source. The letter also preserves other customer-due-diligence duties.

evidence.locator: letter dated 05.03.2026, pp. 1–3; prior sector letter 10.06.2025, DML-DMLZNA.071.1.2025.KK
section 7, banking discussion; inspected as a secondary assertion

findings.recommendation: Name the document precisely. Present ordinary filing proof as possible evidence of a legal position, not automatically as an identity document or proof of lawful residence in every case.
findings.final_disposition: New published banking copy preserves the stated limits; the upstream-overstatement risk is avoided.

findings.title: A basic-account right and AML safeguards coexist
findings.body: Directive 2014/92 arts. 2, 15 and 16 protect qualifying consumers' basic-payment-account access; lawful residence is a legal entitlement, not a requirement to hold a plastic permit. This is not a guarantee for every commercial/business account. Article 16(4) preserves AML refusal, while Directive 2015/849 art. 14(4) requires action where relevant due diligence cannot be completed. Identity, lawful status and remaining due diligence are distinct questions.

evidence.locator: arts. 13–14; current version link shown as 30.12.2024

findings.recommendation: Distinguish opening refusal, account restrictions, payment-card expiry and termination. Do not promise that a valid passport or pending application makes every restriction unlawful. Check current Polish implementation separately.
findings.final_disposition: New published banking copy preserves the stated limits; the upstream-overstatement risk is avoided.

findings.title: Jenec supports individual assessment, within a specific basic-account case
findings.body: CJEU C-81/24 Jenec, judgment 11.06.2026, ECLI:EU:C:2026:470, rejects automatic basic-account refusal solely because of inclusion on a third-country sanctions list, requiring an individual AML assessment. It strengthens the argument against blanket exclusion; it does not decide every migrant document-expiry restriction or remove EU sanctions and AML duties. The official case record, operative part and official abstract were checked; a full-judgment paragraph review remains with the legal workstream.

evidence.locator: judgment/operative part, 11.06.2026; official abstract ECLI:EU:C:2026:470
official abstract

findings.recommendation: Use the narrow holding, then clearly label any extension to expiry-related restrictions as an argument rather than an adjudicated conclusion.
findings.final_disposition: Full official judgment paragraphs34–56 independently reviewed; new copy remains calibrated. See phase3-review.json.

findings.title: Supervisory reporting and individual complaint remedies differ
findings.body: GIIF communication 73 rejects category-only de-risking but says GIIF cannot change an individual bank decision. Rzecznik Finansowy intervention normally follows a rejected, partially met or unanswered bank complaint; it assists natural persons, including entrepreneurs, but does not issue a binding decision or interrupt the claim limitation period. These are separate banking routes, not ways to accelerate a residence permit.

evidence.locator: individual assessment and competence paragraphs
conditions, persons assisted, limits of intervention

findings.recommendation: Ask for the bank's stated reasons and a formal complaint; route systemic information to the proper supervisor without promising an immediate unfreeze or requiring public disclosure of private records.
findings.final_disposition: Confirmed within its stated scope or retained as a disclosed source/inference limitation.
